title: When fear keeps writing the script
issueStatement: Fear keeps deciding what will happen, who will leave, and what disaster you must defend against.
centralInsight: Gurbani does not build fearlessness out of bravado. Fear loosens through reverence, Hukam, forgiveness, and the nearness of the One already holding the moment.
practicalReflection: Fear wants guarantees before obedience. Gurbani keeps turning the mind toward the One who remains present before the guarantees arrive.
actionPrompt: When fear rises, read one line aloud before you plan your defense.

practice.label: Steady Practice
practice.title: Training the heart not to bow to fear
practice.issueStatement: Fear keeps returning through habit: the imagined outcome, the quick contraction, the private rehearsal of danger before the room has even changed.
practice.centralInsight: Gurbani does not erase fear by volume. It trains the heart into shelter, remembrance, and a steadier obedience that fear cannot easily bully.
practice.practicalReflection: A fearless life is built in repetitions. Each small return teaches the body that threat does not get to narrate the whole day.
practice.actionPrompt: Pick one fear pattern that visits often and answer it with the same line, the same breath, and the same act of trust until it stops sounding final.
